description: XAUUSD positioning (COT) + cross-asset (DXY) mechanisms. Data that was previously missing is now available: CFTC COT disaggregated positioning 2021-2026 (data/cot/) and DXY 2018-2026 (data/DXY_D1.csv). XAUUSD costs verified correct (0.65 bps rt, commission=0).
notes: Registered 2026-08-06 BEFORE running any backtest (F27 discipline).
Both mechanisms have economic rationale: positioning extremes historically precede gold reversals; USD (DXY) direction leads gold (inverse correlation).
XAUUSD was NOT affected by the commission unit error (commission=0 on Pepperstone Razor commodities CFD) — prior XAUUSD REJECTs stand; these are NEW mechanisms on the same instrument.

hypotheses.name: COT Managed-Money Contrarian on XAUUSD (weekly positioning z-score extremes)
hypotheses.hypothesis: Extreme Managed-Money net positioning (z >= 2.0) on gold futures precedes mean reversion in spot XAUUSD over 1-4 weeks.
hypotheses.mechanism: COTPositioningStrategy (path_b_wrappers): contrarian entry at positioning z-score extremes, exit at mean-reversion (z 0.5), hold 1-4 weeks. Weekly COT data merged onto daily XAUUSD.
hypotheses.validation_plan: BacktestEngine measured-cost path, precomputed cot_positioning_signal feature, pooled DK t + Sharpe gates.

hypotheses.name: Cross-Asset Momentum: DXY lead-lag on XAUUSD (60-day window, z>=1.0, 5-day hold)
hypotheses.hypothesis: DXY directional extremes lead gold moves (inverse USD-gold correlation); entering on DXY z-score extremes with 5-day hold captures the lead-lag.
hypotheses.mechanism: CrossAssetMomentumStrategy (path_b_wrappers): DXY 60-day momentum z-score >= 1.0 threshold, 5-day hold, gold trades against DXY direction.
hypotheses.validation_plan: BacktestEngine measured-cost path, precomputed cross_asset_momentum_signal feature, pooled DK t + Sharpe gates.
